page.overview:
What is Piolin?

Piolin was a locale which featured deserts. While offering water to recently–facehugged Executive Officer Thomas Kane aboard the commercial starship in 2122, and unaware that he was harboring a chestburster, warrant officer Ellen Ripley reflected that Kane drank as if he had spent ten years traversing Piolin's terrain.
